markdown: Basic information about the observations Filament in the NOAA 12159 active region was observed on 11 Sept 2014 9:28 - 10:04 UT at VTT at Tenerife with Eche- Ile spectrograph together with TIP1 spectropolarimeter in IR and simultaneously in Ho by the TESOS Farbry-Pérot interferometer: - position of the filament: 215 arcsec, -420 arcsec; 3 scans made with spectrograph between 9:28 - 10:04 UT - spectropolarimetric observations in chromospheric Hel IR triplet with wavelength around 10830 A, photospheric line SiI 10827 A; height of the slit approx. 30ồẠỊạ 1 pxl along the slit 0.351, scan step of 0.451, scanned approx. 10" - spectroscopic observations in Call 8542 A - 2D observations with the TESOS Fabry-Pérot interferometer, FOV of 25x25i, step 0.025 A of scanning in 2 within interval 6561.2 - 6564.5 Å - the 3rd scan was used, and TESOS observation No.33
